note: Measure used: CDC/NCHS NVSS provisional 2023 (the latest CDC table; there is no 2024 CDC table). Divorce count and rate cover only 45 states + DC (CA, HI, IN, MN, NM excluded), so ratio_pct uses the rates (2.4/6.1) rather than the non-comparable counts (32.9%). Alternative BGSU NCFMR 2024 (ACS, women marrying/divorcing in the past year): 2,390,482 marriages and 986,810 divorces (M/D ratio 2.42, i.e. 41.3%); refined rates 31.2 and 14.2 per 1,000 women; NCFMR gives no crude rates.

Latest StatCan tables 39-10-0055 and 39-10-0051 (released 2022) stop at 2020; exact crude divorce rate 1.129. The year is COVID-depressed (2019: 146,121 marriages at 3.9; 56,937 divorces at 1.51). No official 2021+ national data found; the '~42k divorces in 2023' figure on secondary sites could not be verified.

INEGI publishes rates per 1,000 population aged 18+ only: marriages 5.4, divorces 1.79 (not crude rates, so left null). INEGI's own ratio is 33.3 divorces per 100 marriages. DYB crude rates for 2023: 3.8 and 1.2.

IBGE Estatisticas do Registro Civil 2024 (released Dec 2025). Civil marriages include 12,187 same-sex. Divorces are 350,407 judicial (1st instance) plus 77,894 extrajudicial. IBGE's legal nuptiality rate is 5.6 per 1,000 population aged 15+ (7.1 in 2014) (not crude, so left null).

2023 is used because it is the latest year with a divorce count (38,093, Registro Civil via Emol; lowest since 2008). Marriages are from INE (provisional; DYB rate 3.22). Newer marriages-only data: 2024 61,119 (3.0), 2025p 60,293 (3.0). No official crude divorce rate found.
UN DYB 2024 Table 22 (crude rate 2.84). No national divorce statistics published (INDEC/DEIS don't compile them; the DYB has no Argentina divorce row). Only city/province series, e.g. CABA 2024.

Superintendencia de Notariado y Registro (notarial) figures as reported by the press. Divorces run only to 15 Dec 2024, and the marriage count is also reported as 52,348. SNR 2023: 69,456 marriages, 25,427 divorces (36.6%). Registraduria registered 85,822 marriages in 2024. DANE publishes no marriage/divorce statistics and there are no official crude rates. Low reliability.
INEI/RENIEC registered marriages and divorces. Marriage rate is 20 per 10,000 inhabitants. INEI gives no divorce rate (DYB 2023: 0.49). The ratio matches INEI's '25 divorces per 100 marriages'.

INE Anuario 2024, DGREC marriages occurring and registered. No national divorce series: the latest DYB figure is 2020 (2,555, 0.73), and the Anuario only has Montevideo divorce cases initiated (2,931 in 2023). Latest DYB marriage rate: 2022, 2.78.
UN DYB 2024 (exact rates 4.17 and 2.48). Marriage count flagged provisional. INEC counts marriages registered in the year, including ones that took place up to 10 years earlier.
ONEI Anuario Demografico 2024. The ONEI PDF returned HTTP 500, so figures were taken from press coverage of it; they are consistent with the DYB 2023 figures (79,823 marriages, 20,570 divorces).
ONE Anuario de Estadisticas Vitales 2025, via press. 2024 per ONE/DYB: 44,349 marriages (4.11) and 26,210 divorces (2.43), revised in the 2025 release to 44,645 and 26,369.
UN DYB 2024 (exact rates 2.23 and 0.74). The INEC Panama site was unreachable. The DYB also has 2024 marriages (7,857, rate 1.74) but no 2024 divorces.
UN DYB 2024 (exact rates 3.70 and 1.94). The Registro Demografico's 2023 figures reported in the press (11,801 marriages, 6,266 divorces) differ from the DYB's 2023 values (11,811 and 6,672).
INEC Registro Estadistico de Matrimonios y Divorcios 2025. INEC's rates of 28.7 and 13.8 per 10,000 were converted to per 1,000. 2024: 53,813 marriages, 25,555 divorces.

Marriages: INE microdata for 2024 (70,294 records, matching the DYB). Divorces: DYB 2024, because INE's '2024 divorces' file link actually serves the marriage file. No 2024 rates; DYB 2023 rates are 4.21 marriages and 0.58 divorces. Divorce registration is low.
No data found. El Salvador is absent from UN DYB 2023/2024 tables 22-25, and no recent ONEC/DIGESTYC marriage or divorce publication could be retrieved.

UN DYB 2023, provisional, the latest available. Very likely under-registered: an unverified press figure for 2019 was 82,037 marriages and 22,667 divorces. INE Venezuela has not published anything since. Treat as unreliable.
